newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Rosenbauer gets big Hungary order.
newsitem.headline: Rosenbauer gets big Hungary order.

text.p: Rosenbauer International, Austria's maker of fire engines, said on Monday it had received an order worth around 500 million schillings from Hungary's interior ministry.
The order covers the delivery of 220 fire engines to fit Mercedes Benz chassis, the company said in a statement.

The contract boosts Rosenbauer's current orders in hand to a record high of more than 1.5 billion schillings, the company said without giving any comparative figures. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
